Subject: Exec workshop travel: corporate card holds & pre-pay plan

Hi Susan —

Quick note as we finalize logistics for the Aug 12–13 executive workshop in Boston. A couple of payment/ticketing wrinkles popped up during bookings this morning: our corporate card is being flagged on international authorizations from one of the travel agents (travelsource.com) and two hotel reservations are requesting a pre-authorization that exceeds our single-charge limit.

We want to avoid last-minute cancellations for the attendees. Options we can do from Redwood side:
- Issue a one-time travel advance for the affected attendees (we'll need names and estimated ticket/hotel totals).
- Provide a pro-forma invoice so Acme Purchasing can pay directly prior to the event.
- Request a temporary lift on the corporate card limit from Finance (short turnaround, but possible).

Can you confirm which payment route Acme prefers? If Purchasing needs a formal quote/invoice I can attach an itemized estimate today. If you prefer us to issue travel advances, please send the final traveler list by EOD Monday (Aug 3) so we can process before ticketing.

Attaching a quick estimate template for the attendees I'm planning to prepay so you can see totals.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_travel_advance_estimate.xlsx (xlsx)]

Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 11:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Exec workshop travel: corporate card holds & pre-pay plan

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the heads-up. Our procurement policy requires an invoice/PO before we allow vendor card charges for events > $5k. Two quick asks:

1) Can Redwood generate a pro-forma invoice with attendee names and line-item breakdown (flights, hotel, per-diem estimates)? We can route that to Purchasing for payment.
2) If you need us to accept direct charges to the corporate card, Purchasing will need written assurance (invoice + payment terms) and at least one week lead time.

We have a hard deadline: ticketing must be completed by Aug 4 to lock the group fare. If you can send a pro-forma by EOD today or Monday morning, I'll escalate on our side.

Appreciate the estimate you attached — that helps.

Best,
Susan Lawrence
Director, Events & Partnerships
Acme Enterprises

Hannah —

Thanks for being on this. To keep Acme happy and meet the Aug 4 ticketing deadline, proposal:
1) We prepare a pro-forma invoice today with attendee names + itemized lines and send to Acme Purchasing. If Purchasing won't pay before ticketing,
2) Redwood issues one-time travel advances for the 4 impacted attendees (estimate total $12,400) and Finance creates temporary authorizations for the hotel blocks where possible.

Action items:
- Dev: please finalize the itemized pro-forma (use the estimate I attached) and include payment terms + Redwood invoice address.

- Marissa: I'll coordinate with Acme once we have the invoice or advance confirmation.

Folks — quick update from Finance: we've opened FIN-4521 to track this. Decision and actions taken:

- Approved a one-time travel advance for up to $13,000 (covers estimated flights + two hotel incidentals). Please complete the attached Travel Advance Request Form for each attendee.
- Temporary card limit increase for the hotel merchant was declined (bank requires direct merchant relationship docs).
- Attached is the expense_template.xlsx for receipts and per-diem tracking; receipts must be submitted within 7 days after the event or advances will be reconciled on the cardholder's payroll.
- We've also prepared a short pro-forma invoice if Acme prefers to pay directly; Neha, send me the final invoice PDF and we will route a copy to Accounts Receivable to expedite any offsets.
